lessons.title: From Boscombe to Bournemouth
lessons.subtitle: A south-coast club with a long road to the top flight.

story.title: The early name
story.body: The club’s roots date to 1899, when it began as Boscombe FC. The name AFC Bournemouth came later, in 1971.

story.title: A top-flight breakthrough
story.body: The club’s modern climb culminated in its first Premier League season in 2015/16. Its best finish in the first five-season spell was ninth in 2016/17.

facts.prompt: In what year did the club’s roots begin?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: What was the club originally called?
facts.label: Earlier name

facts.prompt: What was Bournemouth’s best finish in its first five Premier League seasons?
facts.label: Best league finish
facts.evidence: “best campaign in 2016/17 when they finished ninth”

lessons.title: A club takes shape
lessons.subtitle: Brentford’s story began with a local ground and a vote over which game to play.

story.title: The 1889 decision
story.body: Brentford FC was formally formed in 1889. At its first planning stage, local organisers chose association football over rugby.

story.title: A home and first opponent
story.body: The Bees played their first match against a Kew eleven in 1889, drawing 1–1. Griffin Park became their home in 1904.

facts.prompt: When was Brentford FC formally formed?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: Who did Brentford face in its first match?
facts.label: First opponent

facts.prompt: In what year did Brentford begin playing at Griffin Park?
facts.label: Ground era

lessons.title: Albion is born
lessons.subtitle: A local football club emerged in 1901 and soon settled into its distinctive name and home.

story.title: A new club in Brighton
story.body: Brighton & Hove Albion was formed on 24 June 1901 at the Seven Stars pub. Its first proposed name was Brighton & Hove United.

story.title: Finding an identity
story.body: The name changed to Brighton & Hove Albion before the 1901/02 season began. The Goldstone Ground first hosted the club in 1902, before becoming its home.

facts.prompt: In what year was Brighton & Hove Albion formed?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: What was the club first called in 1901?
facts.label: Original proposed name
facts.evidence: “new club was to be called Brighton & Hove United”

facts.prompt: In what year did the Goldstone Ground first host the club?
facts.label: Ground milestone

lessons.title: Made for Stamford Bridge
lessons.subtitle: Chelsea began as a new club created to give the newly built stadium a football tenant.

story.title: The founding meeting
story.body: Chelsea was founded in 1905 after a meeting at the Rising Sun pub across from Stamford Bridge. The new side was formed to play at the stadium.

story.title: First league crown
story.body: Fifty years after its founding, Chelsea won its first league championship: the 1954/55 Division One title. Its first Premier League crown followed in 2004/05.

facts.prompt: In what year was Chelsea founded?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: Which season brought Chelsea its first league title?
facts.label: First league title

facts.prompt: Which season brought Chelsea its first Premier League title?
facts.label: First Premier League title

lessons.title: Cup glory and a league first
lessons.subtitle: Coventry’s history includes a famous Wembley win and a place in the Premier League’s founding season.

story.title: The cup final
story.body: Coventry beat Tottenham Hotspur 3–2 to win the 1987 FA Cup. The victory remains the club’s sole FA Cup triumph.

story.title: A new competition
story.body: Coventry was among the 22 clubs in the first Premier League campaign of 1992/93. The club later won the 2025/26 Championship title.

facts.prompt: In what year did Coventry win the FA Cup?
facts.label: FA Cup triumph

facts.prompt: Which Premier League season was Coventry part of from the outset?
facts.label: Competition milestone
facts.evidence: “The inaugural Premier League campaign started on Saturday 15 August, 1992”

facts.prompt: Which completed season did Coventry win the Championship?
facts.label: League title

lessons.title: The professional Palace
lessons.subtitle: Crystal Palace’s professional story began in 1905 and reached the top division decades later.

story.title: A long football lineage
story.body: The club traces an antecedent team to 1861, but the professional club was formally launched in 1905. Palace first reached the top flight in 1969.

story.title: A landmark cup
story.body: Crystal Palace won its first FA Cup in 2025, defeating Manchester City in the final. It was the club’s first major trophy.

facts.prompt: In what year did Crystal Palace become a professional club?
facts.label: Professional formation

facts.prompt: In what year did Palace first reach England’s top division?
facts.label: Top-flight arrival

facts.prompt: In what year did Palace win its first FA Cup?
facts.label: FA Cup milestone
facts.evidence: “FA Cup winners for the first time in 2025”

lessons.title: Goodison and the first title
lessons.subtitle: Everton’s move to Goodison Park came before its first league championship.

story.title: A new home
story.body: Goodison Park officially opened on 24 August 1892. Everton’s first match at the ground was a friendly against Bolton Wanderers.

story.title: First champions
story.body: Everton won its first league title in 1890/91. The club’s honours list records nine First Division championships in total.

facts.prompt: In what year did Goodison Park officially open?
facts.label: Stadium opening

facts.prompt: Which season was Everton’s first league championship?
facts.label: First league title
facts.evidence: “In the 1890/91 season, Everton won their first championship”

facts.prompt: How many First Division titles appear on Everton’s honours list?
facts.label: League title total

lessons.title: From Saints to Fulham
lessons.subtitle: The west London club began as a church team before taking its shorter name and settling at Craven Cottage.

story.title: A church-team beginning
story.body: Fulham St Andrew’s was formed in 1879 by a school teacher and churchwarden for local boys. The club shortened its title to Fulham Football Club in 1889.

story.title: A riverside home
story.body: Fulham moved into Craven Cottage in 1896. The ground became a lasting part of the club’s identity beside the Thames.

facts.prompt: In what year was Fulham St Andrew’s formed?
facts.label: Foundation year
facts.evidence: “formed a team for local boys ... in 1879”

facts.prompt: In what year did the club shorten its title to Fulham Football Club?
facts.label: Club name
facts.evidence: “title was shortened to Fulham Football Club in January 1889”

facts.prompt: When did Fulham move into Craven Cottage?
facts.label: Home ground
facts.evidence: “took residence in their new home” in 1896

lessons.title: The Tigers reach the top flight
lessons.subtitle: Hull City’s early story began in 1904; its later Premier League debut came more than a century later.

story.title: A new club in Hull
story.body: Sixteen men are credited with founding Hull City in June 1904. The club entered the Football League Second Division for 1905/06.

story.title: First in the Premier League
story.body: Hull’s first top-flight season was 2008/09, after promotion through the Championship play-offs. The debut campaign began with a 2–1 win over Fulham.

facts.prompt: In what year was Hull City founded?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: Which season saw Hull enter the Football League Second Division?
facts.label: League entry

facts.prompt: Which season was Hull’s Premier League debut?
facts.label: Premier League debut

lessons.title: From amateur side to champions
lessons.subtitle: Ipswich turned professional decades after its founding, then made a rapid climb to the top of English football.

story.title: A 1878 beginning
story.body: Ipswich Town was formed as an amateur club in 1878 and became professional in 1936. It joined the Football League in 1938.

story.title: A title and Europe
story.body: Ipswich won the First Division championship in 1961/62, one season after winning the Second Division. The club later lifted the UEFA Cup in 1981.

facts.prompt: In what year was Ipswich Town formed?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: In what year did Ipswich turn professional?
facts.label: Professional status
facts.evidence: “not until 1936 when the Blues turned professional”

facts.prompt: Which season did Ipswich win the First Division championship?
facts.label: League title

lessons.title: A new club after Leeds City
lessons.subtitle: Leeds United formed after the city’s previous league club was dissolved, then built a major honours record.

story.title: The 1919 formation
story.body: Leeds United was founded in October 1919 after Leeds City was disbanded. The new club was formed with support from Leeds City followers.

story.title: Titles in two eras
story.body: Leeds won three First Division championships, with its most recent coming in 1991/92. The club also won the FA Cup in 1971/72.

facts.prompt: In what year was Leeds United founded?
facts.label: Foundation year
facts.evidence: “helped to found the present Leeds United Football Club” in 1919

facts.prompt: Which season was Leeds’s most recent First Division title?
facts.label: Most recent First Division title

facts.prompt: In which season did Leeds win the FA Cup?
facts.label: FA Cup title

lessons.title: Two clubs become United
lessons.subtitle: Newcastle United emerged from a merger and took its lasting name in 1892.

story.title: A merger on Tyneside
story.body: Newcastle East End absorbed the assets of Newcastle West End and moved to St James’ Park in 1892. In December, the club adopted the name Newcastle United.

story.title: The stripes arrive
story.body: The club first wore red shirts and white shorts; it adopted its famous black-and-white stripes in 1894. Its modern identity grew from that early merger.

facts.prompt: Which two clubs combined to create Newcastle United?
answers: Newcastle East End and Newcastle West End
facts.label: Founding clubs
facts.evidence: “East End formally agreed to move to St. James’ Park”

facts.prompt: In what year did East End become Newcastle United?
facts.label: Club naming year
facts.evidence: “East End became Newcastle United” on 9 December 1892

facts.prompt: In what year did Newcastle adopt its black-and-white stripes?
facts.label: Kit milestone

lessons.title: A remarkable European double
lessons.subtitle: Nottingham Forest’s history spans a 19th-century foundation and one of English football’s most striking European runs.

story.title: A club named for its ground
story.body: Nottingham Forest was established in 1865. Its name came from the Forest Recreation Ground where the team first played.

story.title: Back-to-back European Cups
story.body: Under Brian Clough, Forest won the European Cup in 1979 and retained it in 1980, completing back-to-back victories.

facts.prompt: In what year was Nottingham Forest established?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: In what year did Forest first win the European Cup?
facts.label: First European Cup
facts.evidence: “Forest claimed two of those – in 1979 and 1980”

facts.prompt: In what year did Forest retain the European Cup?
facts.label: Second European Cup

lessons.title: Wearside’s early champions
lessons.subtitle: Sunderland became a major force in the Football League’s early decades and added a famous Wembley cup win.

story.title: Founded on Wearside
story.body: Sunderland AFC was founded in October 1879. The club won six First Division titles, with its last arriving in 1935/36.

story.title: A Wembley landmark
story.body: Sunderland’s 1973 FA Cup victory remains one of the club’s defining moments. Ian Porterfield scored the final’s only goal against Leeds United.

facts.prompt: In what year was Sunderland AFC founded?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: How many First Division championships are listed for Sunderland?
facts.label: League title total

facts.prompt: In what year did Sunderland win the FA Cup with Ian Porterfield’s final goal?
facts.label: FA Cup triumph

lessons.title: A non-league cup shock
lessons.subtitle: Tottenham Hotspur began as Hotspur FC and made history as a non-league side in the FA Cup.

story.title: Hotspur takes shape
story.body: The club was formed in 1882 as Hotspur FC and adopted the name Tottenham Hotspur in 1884. It entered the Football League in 1908.

story.title: Cup and league landmarks
story.body: Spurs won the FA Cup in 1901 while still outside the Football League. Its first league championship came in 1950/51, after winning promotion the season before.

facts.prompt: In what year was Hotspur FC formed?
facts.label: Foundation year

facts.prompt: Which year did Spurs win the FA Cup as a non-league club?
facts.label: FA Cup triumph

facts.prompt: Which season brought Tottenham its first league championship?
facts.label: First league title
